rows.grounds: compound sāmyāntara-rasa-āsvāda-mela in locative singular; final -āv reflects sandhi before following initial ā-
ātman compounded with verb anu-bhū in passive sense, expressing experience as the self

items.question: In what union is the self directly experienced?
premises: A union occurs characterized by equality and inner essence.
This union involves the tasting of that inner essence.
Within this specific union, experience takes a reflexive form.
items.inference: The self is experienced in the union marked by tasting the inner essence of equality.
uncertainties: The precise syntactic scope of sāmyāntara within the compound admits nuance.
items.plain_english: In the union that tastes the inner essence of equality, it is experienced as the self.
